diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says V+, datasheet reading says CS
diffs.evidence: The SparkFun SEN-11446 board has two separate 4-pin headers and the model lists JP2 (V+, GND, INT1, INT2) before JP1 (CS, MISO, MOSI, SCK) while the second reading listed JP1 first, so this is only header ordering, not a wiring error: SparkFun Eagle schematic shows '<pinref part="U1" gate="G$1" pin="VDDIO"/> <pinref part="JP2" gate="G$1" pin="1"/>' (JP2 pin 1 is the 3.3V net feeding VDDIO/VS and is silkscreened V+), and the board silkscreen text reads 'font="vector" ratio="15" rot="MR0">V+</text>'.

diffs.diff: acceleration (g, +/-2g range): datasheet reading gives 0.001 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model already uses 0.001 g per count (sim spiReplies scale 0.001 for X/Y/Z and driver _MG_PER_LSB {2: 1}), which the gate does not read from spiReplies; the ADXL362 datasheet states 'Sensitivity at XOUT, YOUT, ZOUT 2 g range 1 mg/LSB'.
